metadata.source: NIH RxNorm & FDA Master Clinical Database

master_interactions.reaction: Synergistic inhibition of coagulation cascade and platelet aggregation causing massive retroperitoneal and gastrointestinal bleeding.
master_interactions.remedy: CONTRAINDICATED. Do not co-administer NSAIDs with low molecular weight heparin.

master_interactions.reaction: NSAID inhibition of renal prostaglandin clearance causing acute methotrexate toxicity, bone marrow suppression, and pancytopenia.
master_interactions.remedy: Avoid high-dose methotrexate co-administration with NSAIDs. Monitor blood counts.

master_interactions.reaction: Synergistic CNS and respiratory depression causing fatal pediatric respiratory arrest.
master_interactions.remedy: CONTRAINDICATED in children under 6 years of age.

master_interactions.reaction: Reduced renal lithium clearance causing severe lithium neurotoxicity, tremors, and confusion.
master_interactions.remedy: Monitor serum lithium levels closely and reduce lithium dosage by 25-50%.

master_interactions.reaction: Extreme CYP3A4 inhibition causing prolonged, severe sedation and life-threatening respiratory depression.
master_interactions.remedy: CONTRAINDICATED. Use alternative non-CYP3A4 metabolized sedatives.

master_interactions.reaction: Combined anticoagulant and antiplatelet activity dramatically increasing risk of major gastrointestinal and intracranial hemorrhage.
master_interactions.remedy: Avoid concurrent use unless specifically indicated for cardiac prosthetic valves.

master_interactions.reaction: Serotonergic hyperstimulation leading to Serotonin Syndrome (hyperthermia, myoclonus, autonomic instability).
master_interactions.remedy: Monitor closely for symptoms of serotonin toxicity or use alternative analgesics.

master_interactions.reaction: CYP3A4 inhibition raising statin concentration leading to severe rhabdomyolysis and myopathy.
master_interactions.remedy: Limit simvastatin dose to maximum 20mg daily when combined with amiodarone.

master_interactions.reaction: CYP2C19 inhibition reducing activation of clopidogrel, increasing adverse cardiovascular ischemic events.
master_interactions.remedy: Use non-CYP2C19 inhibiting PPIs like pantoprazole.

master_interactions.reaction: Additive potassium retention leading to severe hyperkalemia and cardiac arrhythmia.
master_interactions.remedy: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly, especially in renal impairment.
